# Swipe row (`swipe-row`)

Swipe to reveal actions (accessibility actions on the web).

Group: Layout & shells. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/layout';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createStack` (types in `dist/web/layout/stack.d.ts`): `.mh-stack`: children in a column or (`--row`) a row, spaced by `--mh-space-*` (`--gap-<step>`, default `md`).

```ts
export function createStack(options: StackOptions = {}, ...children: Child[]):;

export interface StackOptions {
  /** `column` (default) or `row`. */
  direction?: 'column' | 'row';
  gap?: Space;
  align?: StackAlign;
  justify?: StackJustify;
  /** Rows wrap onto more lines. */
  wrap?: boolean;
  /** Element to render (default `div`). */
  as?: 'div' | 'section' | 'ul' | 'ol' | 'nav' | 'header' | 'footer';
}
```

`createSwipeRow` (types in `dist/web/layout/swipeRow.d.ts`): `.mh-swipe-row` (`.is-open-start | .is-open-end`, `.is-dragging`, `.is-armed` before a full swipe runs): a row whose `__content` (`__main` and the `__more` actions button) slides over the `__actions--start` and `__actions--end` groups of `__action` buttons (`--accent | --success | --warning | --danger`, each with an icon and an `__action-label`).

```ts
export function createSwipeRow(options: SwipeRowOptions): SwipeRowHandle;

export interface SwipeRowOptions extends SwipeRowBehaviour {
  content: Child | Child[];
  start?: readonly SwipeAction[];
  end?: readonly SwipeAction[];
  /** Name of the row, for the actions button ("Actions for Kitchen light"). */
  label: string;
  /** Accessible name of the actions button (default `Actions for <label>`). */
  moreLabel?: string;
}

export interface SwipeRowHandle extends SwipeRowController {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
}
```

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createStack, createSwipeRow, createText } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = createText('Swipe the row, or use its actions button.', { variant: 'caption', tone: 'muted' });

const row = createSwipeRow({
  label: 'Kitchen light',
  content: createStack(
    { gap: 'none' },
    createText('Kitchen light', { variant: 'label' }),
    createText('On, 80%', { variant: 'caption', tone: 'muted' }),
  ).el,
  start: [{ id: 'favourite', label: 'Favourite', icon: 'star', tone: 'accent' }],
  end: [
    { id: 'edit', label: 'Edit', icon: 'edit' },
    { id: 'delete', label: 'Delete', icon: 'delete', tone: 'danger' },
  ],
  onAction: (id) => {
    status.textContent = `${id} on Kitchen light`;
    row.close();
  },
});

document.body.append(row.el, status);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Stack, SwipeRow, Text } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function SwipeRowExample() {
  const [favourite, setFavourite] = useState(false);
  const [deleted, setDeleted] = useState(false);
  if (deleted) return <Text tone="muted">Kitchen light removed.</Text>;
  return (
    <SwipeRow
      label="Kitchen light"
      start={[
        {
          id: 'favourite',
          label: favourite ? 'Unfavourite' : 'Favourite',
          icon: favourite ? 'star-outline' : 'star',
          tone: 'accent',
          onAction: () => setFavourite(!favourite),
        },
      ]}
      end={[{ id: 'delete', label: 'Delete', icon: 'delete', tone: 'danger', onAction: () => setDeleted(true) }]}
    >
      <Stack gap="none">
        <Text variant="label">Kitchen light{favourite ? ' ★' : ''}</Text>
        <Text variant="caption" tone="muted">
          On, 80%
        </Text>
      </Stack>
    </SwipeRow>
  );
}
```
